question: is there an environmental club or anything sustainability related i can join?
answer:
No club in the directory has “environmental,” “join,” “related,” or “sustainability” in its name; these are the closest matches. [2–5]

1STEP (Student Organization): “Students Together for Environmental Progress”; it focuses on sustainability, environmental issues, and Ramapo Green. It offers guided nature walks, D-I-Ys, campus cleanups, and free clothing swaps/giveaways. To join, attend weekly meetings and events. Email 1step@ramapo.edu or follow @1step_rcnj. [3,10–11]

Other options: Garden Club (Student Organization), whose mission is sustainable gardening and community gardening/botany [2]; RCNJ Birding (Student Organization), for birds, ecology, and habitat conservation [4]; and Sunrise RCNJ (Student Organization), which works on climate change, greener policies, activism, and outreach. [5]

Ramapo Green also lists Enactus, Hiking Club, the SGA Sustainability Committee, and Sunrise RCNJ among sustainability-related groups. [6] The Committee promotes student engagement, connects clubs, creates interest groups, and develops sustainability leadership; sustainable organizations are encouraged to have a representative. [13,22] Ramapo Green’s directory entry is a Department. [18] Ramapo Green’s page offers a “Ramapo Green Archway” link: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Green/club_signup. [8]

All clubs listed on the clubs page are open to all students. [12] You can also “Join us for a campus cleanup.” [14]

Sources: [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Garden/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Bird/) [5](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sunrise/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/ramapo-green/clubs/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/ramapo-green/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/ehs/stormwater/)

question: what does the gaming club actually do? like esports or just casual hangouts
answer:
There are several gaming clubs, with different activities:
- Ramapo Gamers Club (Student Organization): for both casual and competitive players; meetings share information about esports events and include either a small tournament or a game [3]. The description cuts off after “game o,” so it doesn’t say more here. https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCES/ [3]
- Ramapo Esports (Athletics): a competitive environment with Tri-State competitions and New Jersey leagues. It is open to all students to learn about, and offers open events; students who try out for provided games can become an RCNJ Esports Player. https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/ [4]
- Ramapo Smash Club (Student Organization): meetings and events for people interested in Super Smash Brothers and other fighting-game franchises; it describes itself as both competitive and casual. https://archway.ramapo.edu/SMASH/ [1]
- Ramapo Girls in Gaming (Student Organization): meetings, events, game nights, and educational and discussion-based presentations; its page describes a safe, free and fun environment for female-presenting people and allies who game as a hobby. https://archway.ramapo.edu/gaming/ [5]

So, there are both competitive/esports-oriented options and social or casual activities.

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SMASH/) [3](https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCES/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-girls-in-gaming/)

question: Are there any dance clubs on campus? I did hip hop and contemporary in high school and want to keep going
answer:
Yes. Dance Company (Student Organization) is open to all students; no auditions are necessary. It performs hip hop, lyrical, jazz, tap, musical theater, and more, with an annual Spring Recital. Email rcdance@ramapo.edu. [8] https://archway.ramapo.edu/Dance/ [1]
Naach (Student Organization - Arts, Community, Cultural, Social) welcomes anyone who loves dance, with no prior experience required. It focuses on South Asian dance styles. Email naach@ramapo.edu. [2] https://archway.ramapo.edu/Naach/
Fusion Dance Crew was formerly the hip hop dance club, but the page says it is not currently active as of 6/12/25. [10]
All clubs listed are open to students. [9]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Dance/) [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Naach/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/dance-company/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/fusion-dance-crew/)

question: im catholic and looking for a religious group or campus ministry, is there one and how do i contact them
answer:
Yes. Newman Catholic is a student organization and a ministry of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Newark, open to all Ramapo faculty, staff, and students regardless of religious beliefs. [1] It offers Sunday and weekday Mass, Eucharistic Adoration, Bible studies, Newman Nights, OCIA classes, service opportunities, retreats, Confession, and spiritual direction. [7] The college lists Newman Catholic among its faith-based student organizations. [9]

For more information, visit https://www.ramaponewman.com/ or email campusministry@ramapo.edu. [7] You can also contact David Donohoe, Campus Minister, at ddonohoe@ramapo.edu or (201) 800-4141; or email campusministry@ramapo.edu. [1] For general faith and spirituality support, Faith and Spirituality Services can be reached at abc@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593. [5]
